tools.name: check_api_status
tools.description: Returns the live status of a tracked free API: whether the last hourly check succeeded, the measured response time, 30-day uptime, the free-tier terms, and whether an API key is required. Use this before writing code against an API to confirm it is actually alive and still free.

tools.name: search_free_apis
tools.description: Finds free public APIs matching a topic, ranked by measured uptime. Filter to only those needing no API key, or only those above an uptime threshold. Use this when you need an API for a task and want one that currently works.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists every category in the catalog with how many APIs each holds and how many are currently up. Use this to discover valid category values for search_free_apis.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Given an API that is dead, paywalled, rate-limiting you, or simply unsuitable, returns free alternatives in the same category ranked by measured uptime. Use this when an integration breaks or an API goes paid.

tools.name: check_mcp_servers
tools.description: Returns live status for the public no-auth remote MCP servers we monitor, measured with a real JSON-RPC initialize handshake every hour rather than a plain HTTP GET. Use this to pick an MCP server that currently works, or to diagnose whether a server you are connected to is down for everyone.

tools.name: list_dead_apis
tools.description: Returns the graveyard: APIs that shut down or moved behind a paywall, with what replaced them. Use this to avoid generating code against an API that no longer exists — training data frequently still recommends these.
